about: A page a place, nested as a reader finds it: a county outside New England on a page of its own in its state's folder; a New England town in its county's folder (Connecticut's, its planning region's), the county a page listing its towns and no rents of its own (HUD gives none); each state a page listing its places or counties, linked. The records are the other vectors' own. Written from the layout as planned, before the importer. Moved for the R pass (10-20): each listing page now opens with its questions answered and its pictures (rent over the years, its places compared), and lists its places dearest first with their rent, rises and burden; given each place's incomes (from .import/incomes.json, its real values), written by the importer and read by eye, the place pages unchanged.
